info.title: Leap Incentives — Fields
info.description: List what each program needs before an application can be submitted, grouped by who supplies it. Authenticate with your Leap API key as a bearer token.

post.description: List the fields, agreements, attachments, and device categories a set of programs needs, grouped by who supplies them: the customer, you, Leap, or the utility. Send `program_identifiers` from **List programs**, and the customer's `customer_eiaid` when you know it. Your **Data Preferences** decide which fields land in the `partner` section. This route takes the same key as **List programs**.

200.description: The requirements, grouped by who supplies them.

413.description: The request body is larger than 64 KB. Answered before the body is parsed.

Forbidden.description: Your key can't make this request. A missing or invalid key gets 403, not 401, with `error` as a string, before the request reaches the route. A key without access to this route gets `error.message`.

value.error: No or invalid API key or JWT provided in authorization header

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request is well formed, but Leap can't serve requirements for it.

FieldsRequest.description: The programs to read requirements for. Maps in the response are keyed by the `program_identifiers` you send.

program_identifiers.description: The programs to read. Send at least one.

customer_eiaid.description: The customer's utility, as an EIA id string. When you send it, `utility_connections` is keyed on it. Leave it out when you don't know it. An empty string or a number returns 400.

AttachmentMetadataEntry.description: Display details for one attachment slot, keyed by the uppercase attachment type. `formats` lists the accepted input formats for a `SIGNATURE`.

key.description: A stable key for this attachment slot.

helper_text.example: Sign with your finger or mouse.

text.example: I confirm the information is accurate.

AgreementMetadataEntry.description: Display details for one agreement, keyed by agreement id.

text.example: I agree to the program terms.

url.description: Passed through for ids whose text links `program_terms_url`.

type.description: How to present the agreement, for example `checkbox` or `esignature`.

location.description: Where Leap records the customer's acceptance.

AttachmentMetadataMap.description: Attachment metadata keyed by uppercase doc type.

AgreementMetadataMap.description: Agreement metadata keyed by agreement id.

AttachmentMetadataByProgram.description: Attachment details keyed by program identifier, then attachment type. Present only when a requested program declares its own.

AgreementMetadataByProgram.description: Agreement details keyed by program identifier, then agreement id. Left out when only one program, or none, declares agreement details.

DeviceCategoryRequirement.description: A device category id, or an id with the subcategories that satisfy it.

OptionalRequirements.description: Optional items, same shape as the required lists.

OwnerSection.description: What one owner supplies. `fields` entries are `table.column` paths such as `customers.email`, `customer_devices.purchase_date`, or `applications.agree_terms`. Lists are sorted alphabetically.

RequirementUtilityConnection.description: Per utility connection requirement. `requires_auth` is OR-ed across programs, `login_method` is the first non-null value (the customer's utility wins), and `login_type` lets a credentialed value win.

ProgramUtilityAuth.description: One program's utility authorization values, before `utility_connections` combines them across programs.

requires_auth.description: Whether this program needs the customer's utility authorization. `utility_connections` sets `requires_auth` when any of its programs sets it. `false` when Leap holds no filing details for the program.

auth_mechanism.description: What the program asks of the customer, derived from `login_type`: `NONE` asks for no login, `CREDENTIAL_SHARE` asks for the customer's utility account login, `REBATE_PORTAL_LOGIN` asks for a login to the program's rebate portal, and `INFO_REQUIRED` asks for information instead of a login. `null` when Leap doesn't know the login type.

login_type.description: The program's login type as Leap stores it, such as `utility_login`, `fact_based`, or `rebate_login`. `null` when Leap doesn't know it.

self_file_url.description: Where the customer can apply on their own: the program's web page, else its login page. `null` when Leap holds neither.

GenericProgram.description: A program whose requirements come from a shared template.

InferredProgram.description: A program whose requirements Leap holds for that program alone.

EnrollmentRedirect.description: Where to send the customer to enroll with the operator.

match_on.description: A device category name, for example `EV_CHARGER`.

match_key.description: Entity field path matched against `by_manufacturer`, default `devices.manufacturer`.

ServedEnrollment.description: How the customer enrolls with the program's operator. Present only for programs that need the customer to co-enroll with an operator.

FieldsResponse.description: The requirements for the programs you sent, in one section per owner: `customer`, `partner`, `leap`, and `utility`. Every map keyed by program uses the program identifiers from `program_identifiers`, exactly as you sent them.

utility_connections.description: Keyed by the customer's eiaid when the request supplies one, else by each program's eiaid.

generic_programs.description: Programs whose requirements come from a shared template, keyed by program identifier.

inferred_programs.description: Programs whose requirements Leap holds for that program alone, keyed by program identifier.

enrollment_by_program.description: How the customer enrolls with each program's operator, keyed by program identifier. Only programs that need the customer to co-enroll with an operator appear.

utility_auth_by_program.description: Each program's own utility authorization values, keyed by program identifier. Read it to tell which program needs the customer's utility login, which `utility_connections` can't show because it combines every program for a utility. A program Leap has no record of gets no entry, and the map is left out when none of the programs you sent has one.

co_enrollment_satisfied_by_program.description: Keyed by program identifier. Each value lists the identifiers of the programs whose enrollment satisfies that program's `co_enrollment_required` agreement.

FieldsProgramIdentifier.description: A program's `identifier`, exactly as **List programs** returns it. Identifiers are case-sensitive, so send and compare them unchanged.

ApiKeyError.description: A missing or invalid API key. Leap answers before the request reaches a route.

error.example: No or invalid API key or JWT provided in authorization header

BearerAuth.description: Your Leap API key as a Bearer token. Send it in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`.
